weight_033.title: 33% A NAME.
weight_033.doc: Three laggards at 33% each instead of 27%: close to fully invested when all three are held.

weight_045.title: 45% A NAME.
weight_045.doc: Three laggards at 45% each. Cash caps the total, so the third is funded only when the first two are not full.

four_025.title: FOUR LAGGARDS AT 25%.
four_025.doc: Four names at 25% each: more of the basket, fully invested at most.

two_tranches.title: HALVES, NOT THIRDS.
two_tranches.doc: A full position in two tranches, so each volume signal adds half rather than a third.

all_in.title: ALL IN AT ONCE.
all_in.doc: The whole position on the first signal.

no_vol_shrink.title: NO VOLATILITY SHRINK.
no_vol_shrink.doc: Names more volatile than the basket's median are no longer sized down (the parent can halve them). Every position is full size.

corr08.title: CORRELATION 0.8.
corr08.doc: Each tightening of the correlation gate has raised the profit factor so far.

corr065.title: CORRELATION 0.65.
corr065.doc: A little looser than the parent, for more trades.

stop7.title: STOP AT 7 ATR.
stop7.doc: A wider stop, which helped the parent's own parent.

fewer_doubles.title: FEWER DOUBLE TRANCHES.
fewer_doubles.doc: Two tranches need 3.0x relative volume instead of 2.0x.
